class VeraGrid.Gui.SubstationDesigner.voltage_level_conversion.VoltageLevelConversionWizard(bus: Bus, grid: MultiCircuit)[source]

Bases: QDialog

Voltage level conversion wizard for converting a bus-branch model to a node-breaker model. Supports Single Bus, Double Bus, Breaker-and-a-Half, and Ring configurations (as desired by REE)

add_spare_position() → None[source]

Add a spare position row to the table. This is especially useful for Breaker-and-a-Half scheme where bays may need to be completed.

closed_ok: bool
do_it() → None[source]

Validate configuration and perform the conversion if valid.

get_bay_assignments() → List[Tuple[str, int, str]][source]

Get the bay assignments from the table. :return: List of (device_name, bay_number, assigned_bus) tuples

Note: device_name is the plain device name (without device type suffix)

get_device_to_bay_mapping() → Dict[str, Tuple[int, str]][source]

Get a mapping from device name to (bay_number, assigned_bus). :return: Dictionary mapping device name to (bay, bus) tuple

get_vl_type() → VoltageLevelTypes[source]

Get the currently selected voltage level type. :return: VoltageLevelTypes enum value

Remove the currently selected row from the table Only allows removal of spare positions (not actual devices)
